text: Hurricane Helene flooded Baxter’s North Cove plant on September 27, 2024. AHA reported that the plant supplied approximately 60% of US IV solutions.
A July 19, 2023 tornado disrupted Pfizer’s Rocky Mount site. Pfizer reported the worst damage in its warehouse and imposed emergency ordering on selected injectables.
Hurricane Maria disrupted Puerto Rico production in September 2017 and worsened existing small-volume IV-solution shortages.
ASHP and the University of Utah tracked a record 323 active US drug shortages in the first quarter of 2024.
Vizient’s 2019 survey estimated that US hospitals spent $359 million a year in labor to manage drug shortages.
